lines.text: 量测与良率：让工艺形成闭环
lines.zh: 量测与良率：让工艺形成闭环
lines.en: Metrology and yield: close the process loop
Inline metrology, defect, SPC, WAT and yield
Root-cause analysis (people / machine / material / method / environment)

lines.text: 输出：电学表现 ＆ Yield趋势
lines.zh: 输出：电学表现 ＆ Yield趋势
lines.en: Output: electrical performance and yield trend

lines.text: 目标：量测稳定、可区分过程变化
lines.zh: 目标：量测稳定、可区分过程变化
lines.en: Goal: stable metrology that distinguishes process changes

lines.text: 先Contain，确认量测可信度与机制，
lines.zh: 先Contain，确认量测可信度与机制，
lines.en: Contain first, confirm measurement credibility and mechanism,

lines.text: 采样策略、控制规则和异常处置流程会随产品、量测能力与Fab政策变化。
lines.zh: 采样策略、控制规则和异常处置流程会随产品、量测能力与Fab政策变化。
lines.en: Sampling strategy, control rules and abnormality procedures vary with product, metrology capability and fab policy
